0.description: <hex:020853E3E90C0DFF25020821E3E90C05FF0D476F6F64206576656E696E67FF0D476F6F64206D6F726E696E6703FF27020823E3E90C12FF0F476F6F642061667465726E6F6F6EFF0D476F6F64206576656E696E670303> and welcome to Worlar's Echo, home of the Yok Huy. I can scarcely remember the last time this village received visitors other than the occasional Pelupelu merchant.

1.name: TEXT_REGYOK6WORLARSECHO_00870_TAHRAFAHR_000_001
1.description: With Valigarmanda on the loose, all I ask is that you let me speak of this land, that we might live on in your memory.

2.name: TEXT_REGYOK6WORLARSECHO_00870_TAHRAFAHR_000_002
2.description: Suffice it to say you have well and truly left your mark on our history. Thanks to you, our memory will live on for some time yet. In return, might I tell you of our culture?

3.name: TEXT_REGYOK6WORLARSECHO_00870_TAHRAFAHR_000_003
3.description: The hero who slew Valigarmanda has been crowned Dawnservant, has she? A most joyous moment in history. Indeed, I may even mark the event on my gravestone.

6.name: TEXT_REGYOK6WORLARSECHO_00870_A1_000_002
6.description: What manner of place is this?

8.name: TEXT_REGYOK6WORLARSECHO_00870_TAHRAFAHR_000_010
8.description: Me? Well, most days I make sure everyone in the village gets enough to eat. I have also been charged with welcoming outsiders, as there are scant few among us confident in their command of the common tongue.

9.name: TEXT_REGYOK6WORLARSECHO_00870_TAHRAFAHR_000_011
9.description: I do not think myself especially eloquent compared to my neighbors here, but please do forgive us if we mispronounce a word or two.

10.name: TEXT_REGYOK6WORLARSECHO_00870_TAHRAFAHR_000_012
10.description: Even should the Skyruin sear our flesh and bones, I am content knowing I will live on in your memory. You must flee from here before you join us in our fate!

11.name: TEXT_REGYOK6WORLARSECHO_00870_TAHRAFAHR_000_020
11.description: Worlar's Echo: where the clattering of stone upon stone gave rise to a great mountain. It is where the Yok Huy began, and it is where we will one day end.

12.name: TEXT_REGYOK6WORLARSECHO_00870_TAHRAFAHR_000_021
12.description: Isolated as we are from the rest of Tural, ours is a homogenous community. We seek only to live in peace with our ancestors and maintain the ancient stonework they've entrusted to us.
